page.layout: One column of index entries with page numbers at the right, under a running head "INDEX". Below them, a centred heading for a century, then a paragraph, then two more index entries. At the lower right, the word "INDEX" in italic, below the last line. Show-through from the reverse side in the lower half of the page is not transcribed.

page.notes: The page number 574 at the top right is not a page header; it is the page reference of the first entry. The heading word "SEPTIMA" is an ordinal word, so no caput number is given. "Eixoνομαχος" is printed in Greek letters that are hard to read; the Greek word is given as Εἰκονομάχος [?]. The final "ij" in "Heraclij", "imperij" and "Armeny" is read as a vowel i, following the rule for i/j. The "INDEX" at the lower right is set as a catchword and may be a heading of the next index section. The 589 at the end of the Mahumetismus line is read as printed but is hard to make out. The lower half shows mirrored text from the reverse side and is not transcribed.
